research_question: Can a deterministic multilingual structural classifier identify explicit user-grounded semantic, procedural, and interpretive learning opportunities without capturing transient, third-party, hypothetical, or ordinary requests?
candidate_constraints: no case ID or exact full-sentence lookup
no benchmark answer or future-response marker
use first-person grounding, durability, directive scope, quoted-phrase interpretation, and exclusion structure
classifier only; no memory write, retrieval, planner, or right-brain change
claim_boundary: Passing can authorize only a new independent classifier holdout. It cannot authorize reflection memory writes or establish downstream behavioral benefit.
